questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘–’ are interchanged?

18 ÷ 6 + 2 – 3 × 4 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given : 18 ÷ 6 + 2 – 3 × 4 = ?

According to the question, after '+' and '÷' are interchanged and '×' and '-' are interchanged:

18 + 6 ÷ 2 × 3 - 4 = ? 

→ 18 + __**6 ÷ 2**__ × 3 - 4

→ 18 + __**3 × 3**__ - 4

→ __**18 + 9 - 4**__

→ 23.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
21 is related to 73 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 28 is related to 94. To which of the following is 35 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(1st number × 3) + 10 = 2nd number.**

21 is related to 73

→ (21 × 3) + 10

→ 63 + 10

→ 73. (equal to 2nd number)

And, 

28 is related to 94

→ (28 × 3) + 10

→ 84 + 10

→ 94. (equal to 2nd number)

Similarly,

35 is related to

→ (35 × 3) + 10

→ 105 + 10

**→ 115.**

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 1".**
